name: last-push-defender
description: A defender whose combined force is mostly naval, with enough infantry left over that losing the ships puts it between the 5% rout threshold and the 15% last-push threshold. 100 naval is 2,000,000 personnel and the 200,000 infantry are 200,000, so once the ships are sunk the defender stands at about 9% of what it started with: WarOutcome.LAST_PUSH, which offers the final push at a cost of a fifth of the attacking survivors.
